briefTitle: A Study to Investigate ALE.P03 as Monotherapy in Adult Patients With Selected Advanced or Metastatic CLDN1+ Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adult Patients With Selected Advanced or Metastatic CLDN1+ Solid Tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Age is listed in the trial metadata as minimum 18 Years, but the text phrasing refers generally to adult patients.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received 1-2 available systemic SOC regimens (based on local institutional guidelines) for advanced disease and being refractory or intolerant to treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior line requirements differ by phase (Dose Escalation vs RDE/Phase II), so they cannot be expressed as a single universal prior_lines check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1, as determined by the site.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received antineoplastic therapies prior to study intervention within specified time frame.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The specified time frame washout window is not a simple lab cutoff and cannot be expressed as a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adult Patients
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Adult age is not explicitly defined with a numeric cutoff in the eligibility text provided, though minimumAge is 18 years.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: metastatic confirmed advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, urothelial carcinoma, and cervical squamous cell carcinoma.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Advanced or metastatic phrasing without specific stage lists.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Phase I RDE and Phase II: Received 1-2 available systemic SOC regimens (based on local institutional guidelines) for advanced disease and being refractory or intolerant to treatment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Demonstrate adequate bone marrow and organ function as per the protocol.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: SqNSCLC and CSCC: diagnosed with a tumor of predominantly non-squamous histology result or adenocarcinoma.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of non-squamous histology for squamous lung cancer matches the inclusion criteria.
